description: This Java source file defines the SequenceUtil class, which manages unique sequence IDs using database-backed sequence banks, including thread-safe operations and database transaction handling.

classes.name: SequenceUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing sequences with sequence banks, providing methods to get next sequence IDs and force bank refresh.

classes.name: SequenceUtil.SequenceBank
classes.description: Inner class representing a sequence bank that manages a range of sequence IDs, handling database locking, updates, and thread safety.

methods.name: SequenceUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing SequenceUtil with helper info and sequence entity details.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID from the bank, with optional staggering.

methods.name: forceBankRefresh
methods.description: Refreshes the sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: getBank
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: SequenceBank.getNextSeqId
methods.description: Thread-safe method to get the next sequence ID, filling the bank if needed.

methods.name: SequenceBank.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the sequence bank by updating current sequence ID and filling the bank.

methods.name: SequenceBank.fillBank
methods.description: Fills the sequence bank by executing database transactions to lock, read, and update sequence records.
